newsitem.title: USA: Raychem stock loses 15 percent of its value.
newsitem.headline: Raychem stock loses 15 percent of its value.

text.p: The stock of plastic products maker Raychem Corp. lost 15 percent of its value Thursday, one day after the company warned that currency fluctuations would continue to pressure its results.
Raychem slumped $12.375 to $69 on the New York Stock Exchange.

The Menlo Park, Calif.-based company Wednesday reported that its profits rose to $68.4 million on sales of $427.8 million in its fiscal third quarter ended on March 31, up from year ago earnings of $41.7 million on sales of $417.8 million.

But at the same time, it warned that "adverse movements" in currency exchange rates lowered its income by about $5 million, and are expected to "continue exerting downward pressure on near-term results."
